- Action: Sent documents via email reference BR-2024-0415. No further action.

**02/04/2024 – 14:20 – CRM Note – Account 7712043 (Miss E. Turner, 12 Willow Close, Kidderminster, DY10 3JY)**

- Advised that the higher charge is due to the additional volume, not a change to her tariff. She asked whether we could offer a reduction given the weather. - Action: Account updated to monthly direct debit. First collection will be on 01/05/2024. Confirmation letter sent by post.

3. Surface Water Drainage and Highway Drainage

For premises that receive both water supply and drainage services from the Authority, the following charges apply. These charges are based on the rateable value of the property as at 31 March 1990, or on the assessed area for new premises.

4. Trade Effluent Charges

Trade effluent discharged to the public sewer is charged according to the volume and strength of the effluent. The charge is calculated as:

Charge = Volume (m³) × (R + V + B × (COD/1000) + S × (SS/1000))

Where:
- R = reception and conveyance charge: 38.20 pence per m³
- V = primary treatment charge: 12.75 pence per m³
- B = biological treatment charge: 28.40 pence per kg of COD
- S = sludge treatment charge: 14.90 pence per kg of SS
- COD = Chemical Oxygen Demand in mg/l
- SS = Suspended Solids in mg/l

A minimum annual charge of £250.00 applies to each trade effluent discharge consent.

**10. Water Charges – Tariff Categories (Effective 1 April 2025)**

The following tariff categories apply to all metered and unmetered properties within the Authority's area. Charges are exclusive of VAT unless otherwise stated. All charges are reviewed annually and published no later than 28 days before the start of the billing year.

**11. Business Tariff – New for 2025/26**

Following a review of non-domestic charging arrangements, the Authority has introduced two business tariff categories with effect from 1 April 2025. Previously, all non-domestic properties were billed under the Standard tariff. The new categories are intended to better reflect the cost of supplying larger commercial premises.

**12. Reduced Tariff – Eligibility Review**

The Authority completed a review of the Reduced tariff in February 2025. The review confirmed that the eligibility criteria remain appropriate for the current financial year. No changes to the criteria or the charge rate have been made as a result of the review. The charge for the Reduced tariff remains at 96.40 pence per cubic metre for 2025/26.

Customers currently on the Reduced tariff do not need to reapply. However, the Authority will conduct a periodic reassessment of all Reduced tariff accounts during the 2025/26 billing year. Customers will be notified in writing if their tariff category is due to change.

Sarah Jones current_water_charge_tariff is Reduced. Record status: current.

Customers who believe they may be eligible for the Reduced tariff but are not currently assigned to it may submit an application at any time. Applications are assessed within 10 working days of receipt. Where an application is successful, the Reduced tariff will be applied from the start of the next billing cycle.

**13. Charges for Unmetered Properties**

Where a property is not metered, the charge is based on the rateable value of the property as at 31 March 1990. The annual charge is calculated as:

Annual Charge = Rateable Value × Multiplier

The multiplier for unmetered properties is 1.90 for the financial year 2025/26. This reflects an increase of 2.7% on the previous year's multiplier, in line with the Consumer Price Index for the 12 months to December 2024. The multiplier is reviewed annually and may be adjusted in line with the Consumer Price Index.

Trade effluent charges apply to non-domestic premises discharging effluent into the public sewer. Charges are calculated based on the volume and strength of the effluent discharged.
